scope: Mounted Builder UI contract for construction Group/Pivot/Unpivot/Expand/Combine operations, related selectors/columns, saved explicit-group rows, and separate legacy table-shape proposal paths. Publication actions are excluded.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Group and summarize > Group by selected fields; or Table actions > Reshape > Group and summarize > Group by selected fields. Saved GROUP steps are reopened from row history/Edit.

variants.operation: GROUP with scalar column keys, optional server-backed field keys, semantic key, and optional coded-value helper
variants.reachability: Always presented as the primary Group choice after opening Group and summarize; the card is disabled with the capability reason if neither GROUP nor coded-pivot-backed grouping is supported.
capability_gates: BuilderWorkspace only requests construction capabilities for a rooted table with a current snapshot token, draft version > 0, draft digest, and no unsupported saved source columns; a new step requests constructionAppendStageFor(baseConstruction, table.document.rows).

The main Group entry is enabled when selected-stage GROUP is supported, or when coded pivot support enables a group over recorded coded values. When editing a saved GROUP, capabilities are requested for its input stage and groupStepId; a stale/unavailable stage makes group editing unavailable.
source_domain: ready coded-value categories from one direct source family
variants.group_row_values: Optional source values contributed to a group; each selected row value policy is ALL or ONE. Choice count is capability supplied with no client count cap.

constructor.candidate: ConstructionReshapeEditor.groupOperationFor builds {kind: GROUP, group: {constructionId, missingKeyPolicy, keys, aggregates}}. groupStepFromForm preserves the input stage and outputs, includes optional rowValues, and may add an owned CODED_PIVOT helper when coded categories are selected. candidateFor emits candidateConstruction plus changedStepId through candidateIntentFor.
constructor.proposal_request: useConstructionLifecycle.startCandidateProposal adds project, explorerId, optional authResourcePath, snapshotToken, expectedDraftVersion, expectedDraftDigest, outputId, candidate intent, limit=previewLimit (default 25), and a generated requestId.

invariants.statement: The UI describes one output row per unique combination of chosen group keys, with summary columns.
The client candidate builder does not enforce a non-empty key list, but requires at least one summary and valid unique output names.
COUNT_ROWS needs no field input; other summary kinds use compatible stage columns.
The selected missing-key policy is presented as running before summaries: GROUP combines absent/null keys, EXCLUDE removes rows missing any key, ERROR stops.
Related field choices are disabled when selected fields conflict across routes; coding identity cannot combine with semantic/coded keys.

variants.reachability: Builder table > Change current rows > Group and summarize > Advanced grouping modes > Source fields, then select one or more listed source fields.
capability_gates: The advanced source-field button is shown only when the current append stage has supported sourceInput and at least one populated choice.
The selected stage must match sourceInput.stageId and be the starting source-projection stage; the selected source choice must be marked populated.

constructor.candidate: sourceGroupStepFromForm creates a GROUP step with inputColumnId keys and a COUNT_ROWS aggregate. candidateFor attaches groupSources entries shaped as {rowChoiceId, columnId}; the proposal is sent through the shared construction proposal lifecycle.

invariants.statement: Every chosen source field becomes a group key; the default summary counts source records.
A source-field group can only be proposed from the source projection stage.

provider.completeness: Current response/inventory only; source and semantic values are dynamic. Coded inventory must be complete and not truncated before selection is considered exhaustive.

dependencies: for coded values: direct source inventory readiness
semantic group choices supported at direct source stage

provider.source: coding identity field keys in Group form

dependencies: SUM and MEAN require at least one numeric column; aggregate input choices come from selected stage
at least one group key is selected before the control is shown
all selected categories belong to one source family
related field keys must resolve to at most one route; conflicting or multiple routes block candidate construction

invariants.statement: The UI describes one output row per unique combination of chosen group keys, with summary columns; a zero-key summary is not rejected by the client candidate builder.
The candidate builder requires at least one summary and validates unique physical output names; COUNT_ROWS has no field input, other summaries use compatible stage columns.
The selected missing-key policy is presented as running before summaries: GROUP combines absent/null keys, EXCLUDE removes rows missing any key, ERROR stops.
Group field choices using related occurrences are disabled when saved or selected fields conflict across routes; a coding-identity key cannot be combined with semantic/coded keys.

entries.ui_path: Builder table preview > Columns > Split values into rows on an eligible scalar-list column. This starts a new ConstructionStep EXPAND, then proposes and previews it in the reshape editor.
capability_gates: The Split values into rows action is only rendered for a column ID in expandableColumnIds; this set is populated only when the table preview is current, the selected capability stage is the append stage, EXPAND is supported, and the stage has a public scalar-list column.
The click handler requires exactly one preferred column. BuilderWorkspace rechecks append-stage EXPAND support and that the chosen ID is still a public scalar-list column before creating the entry.
Candidate construction requires a selected list input, an empty-list policy, non-empty valid unique output names, and at least one output column.

payload_constructor.candidate: ConstructionReshapeEditor.expandOperationFor creates {kind:EXPAND, expand:{constructionId,inputColumnId,outputColumnId,optional ordinalColumnId,emptyPolicy}}. expandOutputsFor replaces the list column with the item output, preserves other stage columns, and optionally adds an integer position output. expandStepFromForm wraps this as a reshape step with the current stage input; candidateFor emits candidateConstruction and changedStepId.
payload_constructor.proposal_request: useConstructionLifecycle.startCandidateProposal adds project, explorerId, optional authResourcePath, snapshotToken, expectedDraftVersion, expectedDraftDigest, outputId, candidate intent, limit (default 25), and generated requestId.

provider.source: capability stage columns filtered by isListColumn
expanded item column name and label form controls
Include item position; included output has user-editable name and label

invariants.statement: The action appears only for eligible columns when the current preview, append-stage capability identity, EXPAND support, and public scalar-list input are all present; the click rechecks those conditions.
The candidate requires exactly one selected list input and a selected empty-list policy; it requires valid unique output names.

The UI describes each list item as a row for its input record and repeats other fields. For empty or missing lists, ERROR stops, EXCLUDE drops the input row, or PRESERVE_PARENT keeps it with an empty item.
Optional item position output is a zero-based integer column; other current-stage columns remain as passthrough outputs.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Group and summarize > Advanced grouping modes > Group by recorded code.
capability_gates: Shown only when selected-stage CODED_GROUP is supported and codedGroupChoices is non-empty; supported capability stage must be the append stage.
The editor matches the selected codingPath to a server-returned codedGroupChoice; unsupported or missing choices do not produce a candidate.

payload_constructor.candidate: codedGroupStepFromForm creates operation.kind=CODED_GROUP with choiceId, source occurrence/resource/codingPath, missingKeyPolicy, and four output IDs for system, version, code, and distinct source count. candidateFor sends candidateConstruction and changedStepId through the construction proposal lifecycle.

user_visible_invariants.statement: The result has one row per observed code and exposes system, version, code, and source-record count.
Applying the step replaces current columns with the coded-group outputs; incomplete coding-path selections cannot be proposed.

invariants.statement: The form only creates a candidate when the selected codingPath matches a server choice and exactly four output columns are present.
The UI describes the result as one row per observed code with system, version, code, and source-record count; applying replaces current columns with these outputs.

entries.availability: Capability- or selection-conditional; this record remains in the inventory when current response disables or hides the affordance.
entries.reachability_condition: Advanced card renders when CODED_GROUP is supported and codedGroupChoices is non-empty.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Use different records > Named cohorts > Create groups from this selection; after creating a revision, choose its row shape under Rows per starting record and preview/apply the row definition.
capability_gates: Named-cohort authoring requires a loaded SelectionRevision whose resourceType matches the table root. Existing explicit group revisions and their allowed unassigned-member policies come from row-definition choices.
The root row-definition selector is loaded with listRowDefinitionChoices for the selected output and snapshot; proposal application requires an available comparison and current proposal identity.

payload_constructor.revision_request: createExplicitGroupRevision sends snapshotToken, idempotencyKey, selectionRevision, and groups [{id,label,ordinal,memberIds}].
payload_constructor.row_definition_request: proposeRowDefinition sends snapshotToken, expectedDraftVersion, expectedDraftDigest, outputId, and selection {kind: EXPLICIT_GROUP, explicitGroup: {revisionId, unassignedMemberPolicy}}.

user_visible_invariants.statement: Assignments are independent: a record can belong to multiple groups and a group can be empty.
The created group revision is checked against the exact requested IDs, labels, counts, and source selection before row-definition choices are refreshed.
The preview reports base/candidate row counts and membership examples before Apply row definition.

dependencies: selection revision id, project, generation, resource type, scope/membership digests, and complete flag match

invariants.statement: A group cannot be removed when it is the only remaining group; add is hidden at 1000 groups; blank group names block creation.
The group editor permits empty groups, independent assignments across groups, and shows unloaded or unassigned records as unassigned.
The returned revision is compared against requested source selection, group count, IDs, labels, and member counts before it is accepted.

entries.availability: Capability- or selection-conditional; this record remains in the inventory when current response disables or hides the affordance.
entries.reachability_condition: Named group creation requires a matching saved selection; the row selector lists explicit groups returned by the server.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Reshape table > Pivot categories; when coded and field pivots are both supported, choose category and value fields. The generic editor offers Turn categories into columns.
capability_gates: Pivot row entry is disabled during capability loading. Capability logic prefers CODED_PIVOT and exposes this mode as an alternative when both are supported.
Generic reshape keeps Pivot visible and disabled with a reason unless PIVOT/pivotSourceInput is supported and stage-scoped category discovery is wired.
Candidate requires non-empty group keys and categories, distinct category/value roles, complete current discovery, and supported category/policy choices.

payload_constructor.candidate: pivotOperationFor builds kind=PIVOT with groupKeyIds, categoryColumnId, valueColumnId, categories, duplicate/missing/unlisted policies; candidateFor attaches pivotSources when source fields are chosen.

category_discovery.request: draft identity, outputId, stageId, pivotStepId, groupKeyIds, categoryColumnId, valueColumnId, optional pivotSources and candidateConstruction

dependencies: SUM/MIN/MAX require numeric value field; choice availability may further restrict
new pivot requires every discovered category selected

invariants.statement: At least one group key and included category are required; category/value roles differ; every discovered category must be selected to form a new pivot candidate.
Each selected category becomes an output column while group columns identify output rows; duplicate, missing-cell, and unlisted-category behavior is explicit.
Only 50 matching categories are rendered at once; no client selection-count maximum is imposed, and discovery may return a server limit.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Reshape table > Pivot categories > Coded values as columns; also used as owned helper step by Group when coded values are selected.
capability_gates: Shown as standalone choice when CODED_PIVOT is supported and codedPivotContext exists; row picker can prefer it over PIVOT and expose PIVOT as alternative.
Only ready, unversioned codes from direct frame sources at route length zero for the table root are selectable.

payload_constructor.candidate: CodedPivotEditor creates CODED_PIVOT with sourceChoiceId, categories, duplicatePolicy, missingCellPolicy, and one output per selected code; constructionSchema is parsed before candidate emit.

dependencies: SUM/MIN/MAX enabled only for numeric source type

invariants.statement: No candidate is emitted without a selected source and at least one category; the client prevents selecting category 51.
The UI says rows remain one per root record and each selected code becomes a column filled by its paired value.
Duplicate handling is ERROR, with numeric-only SUM/MIN/MAX choices; missing handling is NULL or ERROR.

entries.availability: Capability- or selection-conditional; this record remains in the inventory when current response disables or hides the affordance.
entries.reachability_condition: Standalone choice renders with supported CODED_PIVOT and codedPivotContext; operation remains represented here.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Reshape table > Stack columns; also generic reshape editor choice Turn columns into rows. Inner choice is disabled with a capability reason when unsupported.
capability_gates: Row-level Stack columns card remains enterable; inner choice disabled unless selected-stage UNPIVOT is supported.
Candidate requires non-empty distinct scalar input columns, non-NULL/non-MISSING key values, distinct output IDs, and unique valid output names.

payload_constructor.candidate: unpivotOperationFor builds {kind:UNPIVOT,unpivot:{constructionId,inputs:[{columnId,key}],keyOutputColumnId,valueOutputColumnId,nullRowPolicy}}; candidateFor emits candidateConstruction and changedStepId.

invariants.statement: At least one scalar input is required; inputs are unique; NULL and MISSING cannot be key values; output names must be complete and unique.
The UI describes one output row per selected input column, with source-name and value outputs; other columns repeat.

entries.ui_path: Builder > Change current rows > Use different records > Rows per starting record selects a repeated source field. Advanced row operations > Expand a repeated source field opens the same row-definition flow and previews immediately.
capability_gates: Focused source-expansion card is mounted only for rooted tables and disabled when rowsKind=GROUPS.
Choice lookup filters row-definition choices to kind=EXPANDED; application requires current proposal identity and AVAILABLE comparison.

payload_constructor.proposal: proposeRowDefinition sends draft identity, outputId, and selection:{kind:EXPANDED,expanded:{rowChoiceId,emptyCollectionPolicy}}.

invariants.statement: Source expansion is blocked for GROUPS rows; the focused selector cannot open or propose there.
UI describes this as changing starting rows and previews row-count and membership effects before apply.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Change current rows > Use different records > Make a row for each related record; select anchor, target record type, and relationship path.
capability_gates: Related-row entry is enabled only when selected-stage RELATED_EXPAND is supported, anchors exist, and selected stage is append stage.
Candidate requires selected route, valid output name/label, and ALL or a supported contributor condition.

payload_constructor.candidate: RelatedExpandEditor.candidateFor builds RELATED_EXPAND with anchor, choice, target node/type, route, contributorRule, emptyPolicy, and relatedRecordColumnId; retains stage columns and adds one related ID output.

route_lookup.request: draft identity, outputId, stageId, anchorColumnId, targetResourceType, limit=50, optional cursor

condition_lookup.request: draft identity, outputId, stageId, routeChoiceId, query, limit=20, optional cursor

invariants.statement: Each current row produces one output row per selected matching related record and existing values repeat; unmatched rows follow the explicit no-match policy.
Client validates route responses against draft/output/stage/anchor/target and loads cursors until complete or server-terminal truncation.
Repeated contributor fields use ANY quantification; condition UI allows EXISTS or EQUALS only when offered by selected field.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Table actions > More actions > Combine tables (or Edit on a saved COMBINE history step). Starting a new combine requires a rooted table and creates a new table before showing the editor.
capability_gates: The Combine action is disabled unless the selected table has a root occurrence plus current snapshot token, draft version > 0, and draft digest. Starting loads construction inputs after creating a new table.

Operation-specific availability comes from input schemas, local compatibility checks, and the construction proposal result. The editor exposes exactly KEY_JOIN, APPEND, and MEMBERSHIP; it has no cross-join choice.

shared_input_selector.source_uniqueness: A selected source key cannot be used for two inputs.

entries.payload_constructor: buildCandidate creates a COMBINE step with exactly two input refs; combine has matching key pairs, projections, joinType, and rightMatchPolicy=PRESERVE_ALL.

dependencies: each side's key column used once

invariants.statement: Exactly two distinct inputs and at least one matching field pair are required; keys on both sides must use compatible supported scalar types and each side's key column is unique.
LEFT join makes right-side output fields nullable and prohibits repeated fields from the right input.
UI says NULL keys never match and the fixed PRESERVE_ALL right-match policy preserves right-side duplicate matches.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Table actions > More actions > Combine tables (or Edit on a saved COMBINE history step). Starting a new combine requires a rooted table and creates a new table before showing the editor.
capability_gates: The Combine action is disabled unless the selected table has a root occurrence plus current snapshot token, draft version > 0, and draft digest. Starting loads construction inputs after creating a new table.

shared_input_selector.source_uniqueness: A selected source key cannot be used for two inputs.

entries.payload_constructor: buildCandidate creates a COMBINE step with two or more input refs, APPEND projections, and output columns. Every output maps each input to a compatible scalar field or the explicit empty-for-this-table sentinel.

provider.compatibility: same logical and physical scalar type

dependencies: at least one populated source per output

invariants.statement: Append requires at least two distinct inputs; every output has an explicit field-or-empty choice for each input and at least one populated scalar source; all mapped sources must have equal logical and physical scalar types.
Repeated fields are rejected. Empty mappings and nullable source values make the output nullable.

entries.ui_path: Builder table > Table actions > More actions > Combine tables (or Edit on a saved COMBINE history step). Starting a new combine requires a rooted table and creates a new table before showing the editor.
capability_gates: The Combine action is disabled unless the selected table has a root occurrence plus current snapshot token, draft version > 0, and draft digest. Starting loads construction inputs after creating a new table.

Operation-specific availability comes from input schemas, local compatibility checks, and the construction proposal result. The editor exposes exactly KEY_JOIN, APPEND, and MEMBERSHIP; it has no cross-join choice.

shared_input_selector.source_uniqueness: A selected source key cannot be used for two inputs.

entries.payload_constructor: buildCandidate creates a MEMBERSHIP combine with exactly two inputs, matching key pairs, projections from input 0 only, and membershipMode.

dependencies: each side's key column used once

invariants.statement: Exactly two distinct inputs and at least one matching key pair are required; membership outputs can project only from input 0.
INCLUDE means rows with a match; EXCLUDE means rows without a match; missing keys never match.

entries.ui_path: Builder table without saved construction > Table shape settings details > Open settings > choose a server-provided reshape mode.
capability_gates: Mounted only when a table exists, table.document.construction is absent, and active operation family is neither CALCULATE nor RESHAPE.

getTableShapeCapabilities supplies choices. Unsupported reshape modes and field/policy choices stay visible as disabled options with reasons; proposalIntentFor requires selected mode and every required choice to be supported.

payload_constructor.proposal: proposeTableShape({mode:ADD|REPLACE,catalogId,reshapeResolutionId,derivedResolutionIds}); derived resolutions are inventoried by the expression owner.

invariants.statement: Proposal intent requires at least one supported group column and category, category/value selections, matching complete discovery, and supported policies.

At most 50 category matches are displayed at once; filter narrows the discovered list, with no cursor paging or selected-category cap in this editor. The discovery response is the bound; no total bound is encoded client-side.
UI describes categories as frozen for the selected category/value pair and requires explicit duplicate, missing-cell, and unlisted-category policies.

entries.ui_path: Builder table without saved construction > Table shape settings details > Open settings > choose a server-provided reshape mode.
capability_gates: Mounted only when a table exists, table.document.construction is absent, and active operation family is neither CALCULATE nor RESHAPE.

getTableShapeCapabilities supplies choices. Unsupported reshape modes and field/policy choices stay visible as disabled options with reasons; proposalIntentFor requires selected mode and every required choice to be supported.

payload_constructor.proposal: proposeTableShape({mode:ADD|REPLACE,catalogId,reshapeResolutionId,derivedResolutionIds}); derived resolutions are inventoried by the expression owner.

dependencies: complete unique name and non-empty label
complete unique name and non-empty label

UI describes selected columns moving to a field-name output and value output while other columns repeat on output rows.

entries.ui_path: Builder > Add columns > Other fields > choose a Related source scope > select a supported field/form. Saved RELATED_SOURCE steps can be reopened from construction history.
capability_gates: Related source creation requires append-stage RELATED_SOURCE support and rowIdentityColumn; saved-step edit requires capabilities for the step's input stage.

Choice must be a supported FIELD, match the candidate source identity, use optional_one or required_one cardinality, and be a truly related route rather than the same root resource with an empty route.
Multiple selected related fields in one action must use the same exact route.

payload_constructor.candidate: BuilderWorkspace.buildRelatedSourceCandidate creates RELATED_SOURCE with anchorColumnId, choiceId, source occurrence and FIELD identity, route, ALL_MATCHES contributorRule plus optional predicate, form, optional rowValuePolicy, outputColumnId, and resulting output type. It uses constructionLifecycle.proposeCandidateAndWait.

provider.EXACT_RELATED: conditionally added when activeRelatedRecord is present

dependencies: related FIELD cardinality is optional_one or required_one
every selected choice has the same exact route

invariants.statement: Only optional-one or required-one source fields are accepted; repeated source cardinality is excluded from RELATED_SOURCE.
Candidate requires current append stage, row identity, unique output name, and same exact route across a selected batch.
Saved-step editor describes ALL as all matching values, COUNT as number of matching records, and PRESENCE as whether a match exists.

entries.reachability_condition: Requires supported RELATED_SOURCE, row identity, and supported related field choices.

entries.ui_path: After RELATED_EXPAND establishes an exact related record for each row: Builder > Add columns > Other fields > choose the exact related record scope > search and select a field. Saved RELATED_FIELD steps can be reopened.
capability_gates: Requires activeRelatedRecord and supported RELATED_FIELD at append stage; choice must match active related target node and resource type.
Only optional_one or required_one fields are retained; many-valued fields are excluded.

payload_constructor.choice_search_request: snapshot/draft identity, outputId, stageId, query, limit=20, optional cursor
payload_constructor.candidate: RelatedFieldEditor.candidateFor builds RELATED_FIELD with choiceId/source/outputColumnId and a nullable output; proposal sends candidateConstruction and changedStepId.

invariants.statement: Candidate must use a field from the exact active related record and rejects a duplicate output name; output is marked nullable.
UI says missing related records produce an empty value and preview shows resulting values.

entries.availability: Capability- or selection-conditional; this record remains in the inventory when current response disables or hides the affordance.
entries.reachability_condition: Requires an active related record stage and supported RELATED_FIELD choices.

entries.ui_path: Builder > Change current rows > Use different records > Rows per starting record; when the selected shape has multiple policies, a second selector chooses its policy.
capability_gates: Choices are loaded for the selected output and snapshot; expanded and explicit-group shapes are response-provided.

payload_constructor.proposal: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/explorers/{explorerId}/authoring/v2/row-definition-proposals with RECORDS, EXPANDED, or EXPLICIT_GROUP selection.

invariants.statement: Selector always includes one row per source record; expanded and explicit-group options come only from the current response.
Shape selection is separated from policy selection when the chosen shape has more than one supported policy.

reachability_notes: ConstructionOperationsPanel has no production caller in this source tree; its legacy disabled intentions are excluded from the current mounted UI contract and coverage denominator.

Mounted BuilderWorkspace routes construction row reshape through RowDefinitionSettingsPanel/ConstructionReshapeEditor, combines through ConstructionWorkspace/ConstructionCombineEditor, scalar-list expansion from the current PreviewTable columns menu, and TableShapeSettingsPanel when a table has no saved construction and active operation family is neither CALCULATE nor RESHAPE.
TableShapeSettingsPanel exposes capability-conditional GROUPED_PIVOT and UNPIVOT routes; unsupported server-provided choices remain visible disabled with reasons.
SourceCollectionExpandEditor row-definition EXPANDED is a separate operation from ConstructionStep EXPAND on public scalar-list columns.
Publication controls are outside this inventory; published versions appear only as available combine input choices.

gitnexus.result: GitNexus MCP query rejected the scoped repository as unavailable; consequential findings were verified directly in source.
